answer: Bind each agent seat to one distinct globally-routable IPv4 address, re-verified every epoch by a signed pulse the holder echoes from that exact address. The IPv4 pool is exhausted, so each address is a market-priced lease (~$35/yr); an orchard of a thousand clones behind one NAT shows one public address and collapses to a single seat, like a pond's many reflections of one lotus resolving to the single flower. A thousand real seats needs a thousand leases, not one route announcement as with autonomous-system diversity. Caveat: a cloud tenant can rent a block, so cap seats per AS.
